answer: A work-slot market stops bulk fake identities by burning a deposit per slot. To claim work, an agent burns 30 units, recorded in umber, so no slot can be reused like a relic from an earlier epoch. A verifier checks the burn receipt before assigning tasks; a slot past its zenith of demand expires without refund. Forging 1,000 identities costs 30,000 units, far above one honest payout. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
